note: Set B is slightly better because it correctly interprets the 10'-0" dimension on Detail A1 as a 'total dimension', whereas Set A incorrectly labels it as 'distance from opening to edge'. Both sets share significant errors regarding Detail A1, such as swapping opening width and height (claiming 6" width instead of 10") and misidentifying the 4'-2" offset as an opening length. Both also confuse the spacing dimension (1'-1" belongs to A1, but both attribute it to 'Near Grid 5' in some claims). Set B provides more precise boundary descriptions for Detail B1 (e.g., distance to right edge).
remarks: Both sets struggle to distinguish between Detail A1 (Floor Beam @ Grid 6) and Detail B1 (Floor Beam Near Grid 5), leading to swapped attributes (width/height) and misattributed spacing (1'-1" vs 1'-3"). The entity name 'BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5' corresponds to Detail C1 (Roof Beam, W8X13), but both sets bind W10X15 (from B1) to this name.
